activity_summary: You stood in the tiring-house door for The Two Gentlemen of Verona. Kemp's Launce played to an empty rope. No dog came on.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the door, and did not go on.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Played Launce to an empty rope. He was not spoken with.

facets.activity: Stood in the door while Launce played to an empty rope
